label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Unresectable or metastatic SS is explicitly eligible for IMA203 plus mRNA-4203.
cohort_reconciliation: SS requires at least one received or declined treatment line and ongoing systemic-treatment need. The PD-1 progression criterion applies to melanoma, not universally to SS. One listed experimental arm covers the two histologies and different dose cohorts.
extra_biomarker_requirement: HLA-A*02:01 positivity is explicit. No antigen-expression cutoff appears in the saved modules; this does not establish that the external protocol has none.
protocol_uncertainty: Other inclusion/exclusion criteria and LDH thresholds are deferred to protocol. Age at least 18, leukapheresis suitability and clinical exclusions remain. mRNA-4203 shares the otherNames value anzu-cel with IMA203 in the source; do not equate the interventions. Saved recruitment does not establish live availability or benefit.
quotes: Pathologically confirmed and documented cutaneous melanoma (CM) or synovial sarcoma (SS) with unresectable or metastatic disease
SS participants must have received (or declined) at least one line of treatment (including SoC) and are still in need of further systemic therapy.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly named in conditions and compatible with the HER2-positive sarcoma eligibility; no SS-specific exclusion is stated.
cohort_reconciliation: Procurement and treatment are separate stages. Treatment additionally requires active progression/recurrence after at least one systemic therapy and a qualifying available autologous CAR-T product. Pembrolizumab and nivolumab arms share disease scope; Arm B versus Arm 2 naming is retained.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Tumor HER2 IHC must be at least grade 1 (1–25% positive cells) and 1+ intensity. Product release separately requires at least 15% CAR expression and at least 20% target killing; these are not tumor diagnostic criteria.
protocol_uncertainty: Age 1–25, bulky-tumor exclusion, prior-toxicity and other clinical requirements remain. External protocol and live availability are unreviewed; no treatment effect is established by the registry rationale.
quotes: For the patient to meet eligibility, tumors are required to have at least ≥ grade 1 and ≥ 1+ intensity score for HER2 staining.
Available autologous transduced cytotoxic T lymphocytes with ≥ 15% expression of HER2 CAR and killing of HER2-positive targets ≥ 20% in cytotoxicity assay

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly included in histopathologic eligibility despite absence from the shorter conditions list.
cohort_reconciliation: Single first-line advanced-disease regimen. Prior treatment for advanced STS is excluded, with the stated more-than-six-month post-adjuvant relapse and cumulative doxorubicin limit exception. Prior checkpoint/co-stimulation therapy is excluded.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional SS molecular gate is stated. SMARCA4 deficiency describes a different listed histology and is not an SS requirement.
protocol_uncertainty: Design primaryPurpose says PREVENTION whereas title, disease eligibility and regimen describe treatment of advanced disease. Preserve the source discrepancy. Age 18–75, organ function and other criteria remain; external protocol and live slots are unverified. Background response/survival claims are not validated here.
quotes: Previous treatment for advanced soft tissue sarcoma, except for those who relapsed more than six months after adjuvant therapy with a cumulative dose of doxorubicin ≤300mg/m2;
